user.title: Glue Lock
user.description: Home Assistant needs a Glue API key. The key can lock and unlock your door, so keep it secret.

menu_options.credentials: Sign in to Glue and create a key
menu_options.api_key: Enter an API key that I already have

credentials.title: Sign in to Glue
credentials.description: Your username and password are sent to Glue once, to create an API key named "home-assistant". Only the key is stored. Glue allows 10 API keys per account.

api_key.title: Glue API key
api_key.description: The key needs the scopes events.read, locks.read and locks.write.

reauth_confirm.title: New Glue API key
reauth_confirm.description: Glue no longer accepts the API key. Enter a new key.

error.invalid_auth: Glue did not accept the credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not talk to the Glue API. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Glue account is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new API key is saved.

data.fast_poll_after_operation: Read every 5 seconds for 60 seconds after a lock or unlock
